emotion_and_vibe: Precise, objective, authoritative, and clinical. Built for professional strategy developers who demand a command-center feel with extreme data visibility.

usage_rules.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl tracking-tight font-black uppercase text-black

rules: Use sharp edges (rounded-none) for all components.
Use border-collapse style layout. Every panel is separated by a 1px solid black border.
No gaps between main panels (gap-0), rely on borders to separate areas.
Internal padding inside panels must be generous (p-6 to p-8).
Fill 100% of the screen height (h-screen) with grid layouts, no jagged bottoms.

structure.sidebar: col-span-1 border-r border-black h-full flex flex-col bg-white

component_strategies.cards_and_panels: Cardless approach. Use raw div containers with border-black border-[1px] and rounded-none. No shadows for static layout.
component_strategies.buttons: Sharp rectangles. bg-black text-white px-6 py-3 font-mono uppercase text-sm font-bold hover:bg-neutral-800 transition-colors duration-200. For secondary buttons: bg-white text-black border-black border-[1px] hover:bg-neutral-100.
component_strategies.inputs_and_selects: Use Shadcn components but strip away radii (rounded-none). Add solid 1px black borders. focus:ring-0 focus:border-black focus:bg-neutral-50.
component_strategies.modals_and_dropdowns: Solid white background, 1px black border, solid black shadow (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]). No glassmorphism.
component_strategies.tables: Trade History Table must have border-b border-black on every row. Header row must be font-mono uppercase text-xs border-b-2 border-black.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Hard background color flips (e.g., white to black) on interactive list items.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: Instant or very fast (duration-150) for a snappy, technical feel. No slow fades.
motion_and_interaction.chart_interactions: Crosshair should be crisp 1px black dashed line. Replay controls should give immediate visual feedback (active state = inverted colors).

images_and_media.rules: Minimal use of images. Rely on typography and data visualization.

urls.description: Minimalist white architectural grid, abstract financial data visualization concept. Use for Login/Register page background.
Crisp white marble texture with subtle straight black grid lines. Can be used as a very subtle background layer for empty states or modal backdrops (opacity 20%).

specific_instructions_for_main_agent: Install fonts: Cabinet Grotesk (for headers), IBM Plex Mono (for numbers/tickers), and IBM Plex Sans (for UI body).
For the chart, implement an interactive library like 'lightweight-charts' (TradingView) or 'recharts'.

CRITICAL CHART COLORS: Ensure the chart uses EXACTLY these values as requested by user - Background: #FFFFFF, Grid lines: #000000, Bearish (Down) Candles: #2563EB (Blue), Bullish (Up) Candles: #DC2626 (Red), Price Line: #16A34A (Green).
The Replay Controls (Play, Pause, Step, Speed, Jump) must be built as a floating or sticky toolbar below or above the chart, using Lucide icons in sharp black squares.
The dashboard layout should be an edge-to-edge grid (w-full h-screen) with no outer margins. It should feel like a native desktop terminal.
Include 'data-testid' attributes on all strategy builder inputs, replay controls, and trade history table rows.
Do not use Shadcn 'Card' components out-of-the-box if they have rounded corners and soft shadows. Override them to rounded-none and border-black.
Built-in strategy templates (MA Crossover, RSI, Bollinger Bands, MACD) must be selectable via a clean, monochromatic dropdown or list in the strategy builder panel.
